name: a generation panel counts up inside a product chat card
looks: A chat-style input card sits above a results area where a circular percentage loader counts up with a caption beneath it ("generating..."), while a cursor rests nearby waiting. The whole card is framed inside the browser mockup from the surrounding steps.
build: radial-progress-anticipation for the loader (SVG ring with strokeDashoffset, counter text set from the clock, no easing on the number); the surrounding chat card is a static DOM panel with a slightly dimmed, blurred backdrop behind it.
sound: A soft tick on each percentage step, a low hum under the wait.
prompt: Inside a product's own interface, show a circular percentage loader counting up beneath a short status caption, framed inside a chat or input card. Keep everything else in the frame still, so the ring and the number are the only things moving, to sell real work happening.
